name: Trophimus, Sabbatius, and Dorymedontus
troparia: (Tone 8) God, praised in the Holy Trinity,* glorified the trinity of martyrs,* Trophimus, Sabbatius, and Dorymedontus.* By their faith, they conquered the enemy.* By their prayers, have mercy on us, O Christ our God.
kontakia: (Tone 8) The Church honours and glorifies your light-bearing suffering,* O foundation of martyrs and confirmation of piety,* ever-hymned blessed martyr,* wise in good things and glorious Trophimus.* Obtain cleansing to those who hymn you,* with those who suffered with you,* for you are invincible.
